ms.report:
I'm pleased to submit Milestone 1 Proof of Achievement - OgmiosDotnet: Transaction Submission + Typed Ledger Schema & Service Definitions.
This milestone delivers transaction submission and evaluation capabilities with typed Ogmios v6.13 schema support, service contracts, error handling, and 8/8 passing unit tests. The functionality is published on NuGet and ready for production use.
Full documentation: https://github.com/ItsDaveB/OgmiosDotnet/blob/main/reports/transaction/proof-of-achievement.md
